text.description: The message to place into the run's active attempt. 1..65536 UTF-16 code units (the JS string length, not bytes or visible characters); an over-long body is a 400, never truncated. The text is delivered exactly, like every prompt ingress.

expectedAttemptId.description: Target attempt id. Required when the run has several live attempts (race n>1): without it the daemon answers rejected/multi_attempt. A mismatch with the live attempt answers not_active/attempt_mismatch.

ControlRunMessageRequest.description: Live message into a running run. Send with an Idempotency-Key (the message id): a replay under the same key returns the recorded receipt without a second delivery.
